gloss: to have a point; to make sense

definitions.gloss: to have a point; to make sense; to be reasonable
definitions.explanation: Acknowledges that someone's opinion or argument has some merit or logic to it, even if one does not fully agree. Literally means 'there is one reason/logic.' Composed of 一 (one) + 理 (reason) + ある (to exist).

examples.english: His opinion has a point too.

examples.japanese: たしか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一理|いちり}ある⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It certainly makes sense, but I can't agree.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一理|いちり}ある⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}わなく→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I can't deny that way of thinking has a certain logic to it.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used to partially acknowledge an opposing viewpoint before stating disagreement: 「{一理|いちり}ある⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧…」 (You have a point, but...). The expression conveys measured, rational assessment rather than enthusiastic agreement.
This expression sounds thoughtful and balanced. It is commonly used in discussions and debates to show fair-mindedness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一理|いちり}ある (... also has a point)
- たしか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一理|いちり}ある (it certainly makes sense)
- {一理|いちり}ある⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (you have a point, but...)
